newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Pensioner dies, three injured in Russian gas blast.
newsitem.headline: Pensioner dies, three injured in Russian gas blast.

text.p: A pensioner died and three others were seriously injured when a suspected gas leak caused an explosion in an old people's home in the Russian town of Naro-Fominsk on Tuesday, an official said.

"According to preliminary information, a gas leak on the fifth floor lead to an explosion which caused a fire. We can't be sure because it is still under investigation," a spokesman for the Emergencies Ministry said by telephone.
Several floors collapsed as the fire, which broke out on Tuesday afternoon, spread through a whole section of the building in Naro-Fominsk, 100 km (60 miles) southwest of Moscow.
